scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,worker,notify -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @reachinbox/api-service" "npm run dev -w @reachinbox/email-worker" "npm run dev -w @reachinbox/notification-service"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @reachinbox/api-service -w @reachinbox/email-worker -w @reachinbox/notification-service
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,worker,notify -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start -w @reachinbox/api-service" "npm run start -w @reachinbox/email-worker" "npm run start -w @reachinbox/notification-service"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && tsc -p services/api-service --noEmit && tsc -p services/email-worker --noEmit && tsc -p services/notification-service --noEmit
